triplet_protocol.aggregation: For each anchor i and candidate j, count the fraction of triplets where j is chosen over the alternative candidate. Symmetrize by averaging i->j and j->i rates, then convert similarity to RDM as 1 - similarity.
triplet_protocol.paraphrase_template: Reply with only {concept1} or {concept2}. Compared with {anchor}, which option is closer in meaning?
triplet_protocol.prompt_template: Answer using only one word or phrase - {concept1} or {concept2} and not {anchor}. Which is more similar in semantic meaning to {anchor}?
